notes: The two Interpraevent 2004 papers differ from each other and from what is held. First slide date is 15 November 2000 in both. One paper gives it about 600,000 m3 and the other nearly 1 million m3 on 25 ha. Elevations differ: 1,340 to 1,580 m, 1,200 to 1,500 m, and a crown at 1,525 m (already held). The debris flow breaker is described as planned in 2004. No opened source confirms its built dimensions. The gov.si 2020 note gives costs only.
